nodes.label: Effective access resolution (accessForUser / resolveEffectiveAccess)
nodes.rationale: Combines workspace membership role with explicit PagePermission rows found by walking the parent_id ancestor chain (inherit=true), taking the highest access found; explicit page permission beats workspace role if stricter.

nodes.label: Write-gate enforcement (minAccess: EDITOR)
nodes.rationale: The original Task 3 getAccessiblePage didn't enforce a minimum access level, so any VIEWER could mutate. Task 4 adds an optional minAccess parameter; all page/block mutation services now pass minAccess: EDITOR, and permission management requires OWNER.

nodes.label: Real-time collaboration (socket.io) deferred
nodes.rationale: Socket.io presence/block-sync real-time collaboration is listed as optional in constitution.md and the master prompt; deferred and documented as a gap while the architecture and API contracts already support it as a follow-up.

nodes.label: Zustand + React Query state split
nodes.rationale: Zustand owns session and UI-only state (sidebar collapsed, quick-search open) while React Query owns server-derived cache (workspaces, child pages), avoiding duplication of server state in client stores.

nodes.label: Block ↔ TipTap node mapping (one editor per page)
nodes.rationale: One TipTap editor per page (not per-block) gives natural cursor movement between blocks while still allowing node-by-node serialization to the block API; the backend generates block IDs on POST so the editor inserts a provisional node and reconciles it when the response arrives.

nodes.label: Tailwind class-based dark mode strategy
nodes.rationale: Tailwind darkMode:'class' plus an inline anti-FOUC script in index.html that runs before React hydrates avoids a flash of unstyled/light content on reload, because the script sets the documentElement class synchronously from localStorage before first paint.
